This is the official GitHub repository for the R package delimtools (Bittencourt, Collins & Hrbek, 2026).

Single-lucus species delimitation analyses have been implemented in a diversity of packages that use different methods to delimit species. These include GMYC (Monaghan et al., 2009), bGMYC (Reid & Carstens, 2012), mPTP (Kapli et al., 2017) and ASAP (Puillandre et al., 2020). These software run on different platforms (e.g. R, Unix, webservers), and also do not output their results in a consistent format to allow easy comparison.
